answers.answer: P028 exists: first region of system 7, rapid treble figuration above dotted-quarter/eighth/half bass octaves. Audiveris skips this region; its ordinal 28 is labelled 29 and corresponds to P029.

P024 has four quarters. Upper principal melody C#5 quarter, B4 eighth, B4 eighth, A5 quarter, A5 quarter; the lower upper voice rests an eighth then attacks seven eighth-note chords. There is no quarter-sixteenth displacement or tuplet in the print. A reader timing drift is not a frame change.

P012–P013 lower staff remains bass F4; no octave sign or clef change. Audiveris inherits an absent bass clef and its lower-staff pitches are displaced. Read the lower staff in bass clef rather than transposing the print.
P008 lower staff begins F#3/A3 half chord in bass F4. No treble or octave change; upper staff remains treble. Audiveris lower pitches G4/E5 etc do not match the print.
P030 lower staff is bass F4 with A2/E3 opening and A3/C#4/E4 closing offbeat chords. No octave or clef change. Audiveris high lower-staff readings do not match the print.
The opening lower clef is bass F4, clearly printed. Audiveris missing clef is a reader omission.
No 2/2 or other meter change is printed in P023; opening common time persists. Reject the reader declaration.
Bass F4 is reprinted at the system-6 opening P024 as continuation context; it is not a change from the preceding lower clef.
Three sharps are reprinted at the P024 system opening, continuing A major; there is no new key signature.
P024 has no printed 2/2 declaration; common time continues.
At P006 onset 1/2, upper chord is E4/A4, not B4; lower chord C#3/A3 is simultaneous. B4 belongs to the later chord at onset 3/2. Reader agreement does not establish the claimed onset.
P007 opening dotted-quarter upper chord contains E4/A4/C#5. A4 is printed. Lower simultaneous chord is F#3/A3/C#4.
P007 onset 3/2 is the isolated C#5 eighth. F#4 belongs to the chord at onset 2, not 3/2.
P007 onset 3/2 is the isolated C#5 eighth. A4 belongs to the chord at onset 2, not 3/2.
P009 opening dotted-quarter upper chord contains C#4/F#4/A4. F#4 is printed; lower F#3/A3 does not replace it.
P009 onset 2 contains an inner D4 half note beneath upper A4 and B4. D4 is printed in a simultaneous line, not an alternative to the melody.
P014 onset 3 upper eighth chord is G#4/B4. B4 is printed independently of the lower repeated E3 accompaniment.
P014 onset 7/2 upper eighth chord is F#4/A4. A4 is printed independently of lower E3.
P018 opening upper chord contains A3/B3/D#4/F#4. The sharp on D4 is printed; omitting the inner chord members is not justified.
P027 lower A2 whole note is printed at onset zero. The upper figuration does not replace it.
P027 lower C#3 quarter is printed at onset zero above the A2 whole note. Retain separate durations.
P027 upper onset zero is A3 sixteenth below the treble staff. The return starts below the opening P001 chord; do not substitute E4/C#5.
P027 onset 1/4 is E4 sixteenth.
P027 onset 3/4 is E4 sixteenth.
P027 onset 3 is C#5 sixteenth. E4 occurs earlier in the figuration; reject an E4 onset at quarter 3.

P029 onset 3/2 contains D4/B4. F#4 lies on the intervening sixteenths, not onset 3/2.
P029 onset 3/2 contains D4/B4. B4 is present.
